name: beffroi/saml2-bindings
description: The HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST bindings of SAML 2.0 for PHP, on beffroi/saml2-model and beffroi/xml-security: a query string or a form decoded into the document the model reads, the detached signature of HTTP-Redirect verified over the octets the sender signed and nothing else, and a message the model writes turned into a URL or a form's fields. Strings and arrays in and out, no HTTP object.
